name: card-window-smoke
description: Installs @annetaan/card-window from the npm registry and checks that it can be imported, bundled and type-checked.

scripts.test: npm run test:cjs && npm run test:esm && npm run test:bundle && npm run test:types
scripts.use:local: cd ../packages/main && npm pack --pack-destination ../../smoke/dist && cd ../../smoke && npm install --no-save ./dist/annetaan-card-window-*.tgz
